_source: Morning_Report_Scorecard.pdf — the printed strike-out card. Sixteen items in two columns plus four automatic fails. The web scorecard and the CLI both read this file; do not restate the items anywhere else.
title: Strike it out
lede: Cross each one off as it happens. What is left standing at 0:25 is the feedback — no debrief required.
footer: One per session. If the same box survives four weeks running, that is the thing to teach.
_derived_note: `derived` names a key in the board archive's derived block. Those items arrive pre-ticked and marked, and the facilitator can override any of them. Six are the ones the spec lists; test_named and any_struck are here on the same footing because they are board fields too, not judgements.

items.text: De-identified — no MRN, no dates, no burned-in IDs
History and exam in one block — no labs yet
Stopped talking and let the silence run
Reveal named what was missed, and why
Three to four diagnoses, each with a reason
A framework named before the list
Something struck off, with the reason beside it
Confidence stated, and what would change my mind

automatic_fails_title: It did not hit the standard if any of these are true

automatic_fails.text: The diagnosis came out before the second pass finished
